fields.description: ARLO offers one to three bedroom apartments and three-bedroom townhouses near Creek Beach in Dubai Creek Harbour. Large windows and private balconies connect the homes to their surroundings. The townhouse collection adds a different way to live here, with three levels and rooftop terraces rather than a standard single-floor apartment layout.

research.community: Dubai Creek Harbour · near Creek Beach
overview: The brochure combines an industrial-inspired interior palette with natural materials and generous windows. Communal areas are designed with high ceilings, while a yoga zone, meditation spaces and fitness facilities support everyday use. Ground-floor homes are described as opening towards the creek promenade; confirm the access route and privacy conditions of the particular unit. Energy-efficient systems and waste-management measures form part of the published design brief.
research.locationNote: Emaar places ARLO near Creek Beach and the waterfront promenade, with a neighbourhood park described as roughly 80 metres away. Creek Marina, Harbour Promenade and Central Park are among the surrounding destinations. Advertised walking times to metro services should be checked against current station locations and opening dates.
research.priceNote: Emaar advertises AED 1.7m. The May 2024 launch sheet lists one, two and three bedroom apartments from AED 1.7m, 2.7m and 4.7m, and townhouses from AED 5.6m. These historical category prices do not establish current stock or resale terms.
research.paymentNote: The launch plan totals 90% before completion and 10% at completion. It is a historical schedule; request current outstanding instalments and contract terms for a specific purchase.
research.handoverNote: October 2028 is the estimated completion month reported by the project fact sheet and Property Finder. Confirm the current contractual programme; the portal’s construction update is dated October 2025 and is not a present-day inspection.

facts.label: Launch collection
facts.value: The fact sheet reports 431 homes, including apartments and townhouses. This is not current inventory.

facts.label: Townhouse arrangement
facts.value: The lower floor contains a bedroom, maid’s room and living/kitchen space; two bedrooms occupy the middle floor. The upper level combines another living space with a rooftop terrace. Published suite areas are 2,146.65 or 2,157.20 sq ft, with outdoor components accounting for the larger total.

facts.label: One-bedroom balcony choices
facts.value: The 829.36 sq ft first-floor unit 02 includes a 176.42 sq ft balcony. Many upper-floor one-bedroom plans have approximately 55 sq ft of balcony space. Compare internal area and outdoor space separately.

facts.label: Availability caution
facts.value: Property Finder displays a sold-out label alongside a starting price and resale listings. A displayed price does not confirm a developer allocation; availability and sale type need checking for the individual home.
